system.benefit: The character gains a +4 bonus on the following checks and saves: hourly @Check[skill:swim]{Swim check}s to avoid becoming fatigued, @Check[ability:con]{Constitution check}s to continue running, @Check[ability:con]{Constitution check}s to hold the character’s breath, @Check[ability:con]{Constitution check}s to avoid damage from starvation or thirst, @Check[save:fort]{Fortitude save}s to avoid damage from hot or cold environments, and @Check[save:fort]{Fortitude save}s to resist suffocation or drowning.
system.normal: A character without this feat who sleeps in armor is automatically fatigued the following day.
